build_ViTModel: build a Vision Transformer model with configurable patch size, depth, and number of attention heads
create_posemb_sincos_2d: create 2D sinusoidal position embeddings for a given height, width, and embedding dimension
build_MlpBlock: build a transformer MLP feed-forward block with GELU activation and configurable hidden dimension
build_MAPHead: build a multi-head attention pooling head that reduces sequence tokens to a single pooled vector
build_Encoder: build a transformer encoder stack with optional layer scanning and gradient checkpointing support
